description: Join LaKesha Womack and North Carolina Democratic Party Chair Anderson Clayton for the Cleveland County stop of the Rooted in Community Tour. Meet us for an informal conversation with community leaders and neighbors about the opportunities and challenges facing Cleveland County.
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Committee to Elect LaKesha Womack
title: Rooted in Community: Cleveland County Listening Tour — LaKesha Womack for NC-14
